name: Bramble Needle (Kinh Cức Châm)

arts.name: Bramble Flick (Kinh Cức Đạn)
arts.rule: A thorn flicked from a needle: a quick Wood hit that lays 2 Poison stacks for 8 s.

lore: A needle of blackthorn that hunters keep dipped in sap; its tip never quite dries.
build_use: The Slow Garden's first weapon: a cheap, quick Poison source whose batches last longer, before the Green Wood Heaven Canon arts arrive.

name: Sprout Ring (Manh Nha Giới)
lore: A ring of green wood with a living bud that never opens.
build_use: The Evergreen Wall's early ring: faster health regeneration, a stronger Wood buff and a little more health.

name: Heartwood Hatchet (Tâm Mộc Phủ)

arts.name: Fell the Rotting Tree (Phạt Hủ Mộc)
arts.rule: Counts as a Rotting Canopy Canon art. A heavy Wood chop that lays 2 Poison stacks for 8 s. With 10 Poison on the foe, or 2 canopy arts fired in the last second, it eats 8 Poison stacks (every 4 a Chaos hit) and falls 2.4 times as hard.

lore: A woodcutter's hatchet whose haft is a single piece of heartwood; it is happiest in dead timber.
build_use: The Woodcutter and the Rotting Canopy builds: a heavy chop that cashes a Poison pile into one big hit and counts as a canopy art for Thornling Grove and Blight Canker.

name: Ironbark Cuirass (Thiết Bì Giáp)

wards.name: Ironbark Shell (Thiết Bì Xác)
wards.notes: The starter shell at 1.3 times its payload and its cast cost, so the price check is unchanged (4.711 of 4.766)

lore: Plates of ironbark lashed over a hide of moss; the bark grows back overnight.
build_use: The Evergreen Wall: heavy armour whose regeneration and healing taken carry the long fight, with a thicker Physical shell against sword and fist foes.

name: Sap-Heart Pendant (Dịch Tâm Bội)

reserve_arts.name: Verdant Aura (Thanh Diệp Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your Wood buff stacks last 20 % longer and your health regenerates 20 % faster.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 12 % reserved buys up to 12 W; this grants 10 W

lore: Green jade with a drop of amber sap at its heart, warm like a pulse.
build_use: The Evergreen Wall and the Vine Garden: a standing Wood-buff and regeneration upgrade paid in linh lực, not in an art slot.

name: Verdant Cycle Seal (Thanh Hoàn Ấn)

arts.name: Seal of the Turning Season (Chuyển Quý Ấn)
arts.rule: Counts as a Verdant Cycle Scripture art. A slow Wood seal that gives you 3 Wood stacks for 8 s. With 3 Seeds (spent) and either Rooted Form or 8 Wood stacks, it falls 2.8 times as hard and heals 2 %.

lore: A jade seal carved with the four seasons, cut in the Verdant Cycle lineage so their scripture's arts answer to it.
build_use: Verdant Cycle Scripture builds: a fifth suite art that plants and spends Seeds with the rest, a steady Wood-stack payoff for Seed of Spring and Harvest Bloom.

name: Heartwood Bulwark (Tâm Mộc Thuẫn)

effects.name: Sap Rises (Nhựa Thăng)
effects.rule: Each Wood buff stack you hold adds 1 % healing, up to 20 %.
effects.from: single-wood.md, The Evergreen Wall (its New piece)

wards.name: Heartwood Ward (Tâm Mộc Chướng)
wards.notes: The starter shield at 1.6 times its shield and its cast cost, so the price check is unchanged (3.750 of 3.813)

lore: A round shield cut from the heart of a thousand-year tree; it drinks rain and heals its own cracks.
build_use: The Evergreen Wall: a shield to cast on cooldown, while Sap Rises turns the Wood stacks it keeps up into healing.

name: Ring of the Slow Garden (Hoãn Viên Giới)
lore: A ring of root, grown around a finger over a whole spring and never taken off.
build_use: The Slow Garden: longer, stronger Poison batches, linh lực leech to keep casting, and Spillover so every tick drains the foe's linh lực.

name: Grave-Silk Robe (Mộ Ti Bào)

wards.name: Grave-Silk Veil (Mộ Ti Sa)
wards.notes: The starter veil at 1.5 times its payload and its drain, so the price check is unchanged (4.545 of 4.575)

holder: An elder of a Wood or poison sect at Nascent Soul; otherwise Lost in a sunken tomb in a poison marsh
lore: Woven from the silk of a corpse-spider that fed on a thousand graves; rot spreads wherever its wearer looks.
build_use: The Slow Garden's keystone piece: Corpse Rot is on the foe from the first second without an art slot, the Poison lasts and bites harder, and the veil answers Wood's Fire weakness.

name: Thousand Roots Banner (Vạn Căn Kỳ)

effects.name: Gripping Root (Triền Căn)
effects.rule: When your Physical Wood hit lands, the target's art with the least time left is delayed by 0.5 s, once per 2 s.
effects.reads: Your Physical Wood hits landing, instant
effects.payload: The target's soonest art is delayed 0.5 s
effects.from: single-wood.md, The Strangler Fig (its New piece)

reserve_arts.name: Web of Roots (Căn Võng)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your Poison stacks on a rooted foe are 20 % stronger.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 15 % reserved buys up to 15 W; this grants 5 W

holder: The keeper of a Green Wood Array grove in a Wood sect; otherwise Lost in a forest spirit's hollow
lore: A banner whose cloth is a mat of living roots; it was planted in the ground of a sect that no longer stands.
build_use: The Strangler Fig: every thorn hit delays the foe's next art while Poison works, and the banner's art speed and Physical damage speed the thorns.
